blocks.raw: DriveHub 2.17.0 Release includes a number of new features, feature enhancements and bug fixes.

blocks.raw: ## Cancel/Rebill Dashboard
blocks.text: Cancel/Rebill Dashboard

blocks.raw: The new dashboard in DriveHub is tied to our new Cancel/Rebill API. It enables our Internal Operations team to review and approve requests initiated by partners via API, and enables partners to monitor the status of their requests. This finally enables partners to initiate cancel/rebills on their own, process requests faster, and have transparency

blocks.raw: ## Cancel/Rebill from Ticket Audit
blocks.text: Cancel/Rebill from Ticket Audit

blocks.raw: In addition to the primary expectation for our partners to initiate Cancel and Rebills via API, both our Internal Operations team and partners will have the ability to initiate it from the Ticket Audit screen in DriveHub, ultimately hitting the same API and landing on the same dashboard above. At launch, it will only support equities, but we will expand to support Mutual Funds in the future.

blocks.raw: ## Frozen Account Status
blocks.text: Frozen Account Status

blocks.raw: DriveHub users now have the ability to select the Frozen status when editing a customer’s account details. When it is selected, a secondary new field ‘Reason for Status Change’ will display, and the user will be required to select from a list of reasons.

blocks.raw: **Batch -** Fixing time restriction and copy to reflect correct time window for partners. We encountered an issue where the time window was showing a full 24 hour period, for example, 12:00AM to 12:00AM. We’ve fixed this to reflect the actual intended time window.
